user.title: Connect to Västtrafik
user.description: To use this integration, you need your own account in the Västtrafik developer portal and access to Planera Resa API v4. Enter the Client ID and Client secret for your application.

data_description.client_id: Client ID from your application in the Västtrafik developer portal.
data_description.client_secret: Client secret from the same application. It is stored in Home Assistant and used to authenticate with the Västtrafik API.

error.invalid_auth: The API credentials could not be verified.
